title: Accrual releases begin
body: Starting in the second quarter of 1999, line-cost accruals were released to reduce reported line costs without support: $40 million in Q2 1999, rising to $828 million in Q3 2000 and $797 million in Q4 2000 (total $3.297 billion).

title: "Close the Gap"
body: Throughout much of 2001, Business Operations and Revenue Accounting tracked the gulf between projected and target revenue and found items to bridge it — a process presented to Ebbers and Sullivan as "Close the Gap".

title: No support for the entries
body: On June 17, 2002, Cynthia Cooper and Glyn Smith of Internal Audit asked Betty Vinson about the prepaid-capacity entries; she said she had made an entry but did not know what it was for. Buford Yates sent them to David Myers, who said he had no support for the entries and would not create any.
